2609.24629.title: Augmented Hypothesis Testing with Persona-Based LLM Simulations
2609.24629.paper_summary: A/B testing requires large sample sizes, long timelines, and significant costs. When auxiliary predictions of experimental outcomes are available from machine learning models, uncertain prediction quality precludes replacing human experiments entirely, yet these predictions may still contain useful signal. We propose a principled framework for learning-augmented hypothesis testing that leverages predictions of unknown quality to reduce sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity. Predictions naturally vary in granularity, from coarse aggregate signals to fine-grained individual-level estimates, and our framework addresses both ends of this spectrum: (1) for population-level directional predictions, where only a binary signal on the treatment effect sign is available, we use an asymmetric test and prove consistency and robustness bounds within the learning-augmented algorithms paradigm; (2) for individual-level predictions, we introduce Generalized PPI++ (GPPI), extending Prediction-Powered Inference to handle nonlinear prediction errors through higher-dimensional transformations. Both methods benefit from accurate predictions while remaining robust to inaccurate or adversarial ones. We validate our framework using persona-based LLM simulations, where AI agents equipped with user personas predict individual behavior, as a natural prediction source spanning both granularity levels. Experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods, combined with persona-based predictions, substantially reduce experimental costs while preserving rigorous statistical validity.
2609.24629.paper_summary_zh: A/B 測試需要大量的樣本、長時間的時間線和顯著的成本。當機器學習模型提供實驗結果的輔助預測時，不確定的預測質量使得完全取代人類實驗變得不可能，但這些預測仍然可能包含有用的信號。我們提出了一個原則性框架，用於學習增強的假設檢驗，利用未知質量的預測來減少樣本大小，同時保持統計有效性。預測在粒度上自然變化，從粗略的聚合信號到細緻的個體級估計，我們的框架針對這個範疇的兩端進行處理：(1) 對於人口級的方向性預測，當只有治療效果符號的二元信號可用時，我們使用不對稱檢驗，並在學習增強算法範疇內證明一致性和穩健性界限；(2) 對於個體級預測，我們引入了廣義 PPI++ (GPPI)，擴展了預測驅動推斷，以通過高維變換處理非線性預測誤差。這兩種方法都受益於準確的預測，同時對不準確或對抗性的預測保持穩健。我們使用基於角色的 LLM 模擬來驗證我們的框架，其中配備用戶角色的 AI 代理預測個體行為，作為一個自然的預測來源，涵蓋了兩個粒度級別。在四個真實世界數據集上的實驗表明，我們的方法結合基於角色的預測，顯著降低了實驗成本，同時保持嚴謹的統計有效性。
